bullets.content: [general] Check min_quality after every mesh() before solve(). A mesh with min_quality 0.034 (<0.1) was invalid yet still used a solve. Re-mesh with smaller h or gentler grading first.

[general] Use all 4 solves (leaving 2 unused was flagged twice): S1 control, view error and note top-5 hotspot local h, S2 one single-factor structural change, compare(1,2) between DIFFERENT solves, then best combination; submit by e\u00b2\u00b7N.

[general] After every second-or-later solve, compare(prev,new) with two DIFFERENT meshes (never compare(a,a): meaningless 0.0128); read stress_diff_energy_norm_rel and the region list. Strain energy is a poor convergence metric.

[general] After every solve view(kind=error,iso); write each top-6 hotspot's local h vs requested size. If delivered h >1.2x requested, shrink the request or move a box onto it; refine top hotspot ~0.6x local h.
[general] Never resubmit an exact previous recipe: meshing is deterministic, giving identical nodes, energy and score. Change at least one refinement by >=10% or add/drop a target.
[general] When error is already below target, DOF cost dominates: test coarser variants before adding refinement.
[general] compare() between two remeshes of 0.13-0.17 is noise (e.g. 0.136 for h 0.019 vs 0.03). Decide by strain-energy change, hotspot local h and e\u00b2\u00b7DOFs, not compare alone.
[general] Before solving a DOF-saving cut, price the control mesh too. If nodes drop <2%, abandon the cut: dropping the band saved 0.4% DOFs but cost 2.6% field (e\u00b7DOFs 1372->1401).

[general] One factor per solve: changing h 0.008->0.007 AND upper 0.0043->0.0045 made the -0.18% energy at -4.3% DOFs unattributable. Bundle factors only in a final combination solve after each passed alone.

[general] Energy below a known control on the same frame by >=0.1% signals field loss (~1% per 0.1%): 2.13042e-4 vs 2.1326e-4 predicted 8.89% vs 8.67%. Reject the cut immediately and restore the refinement.
[general] Order-1 sizing: at equal DOFs P1 needs ~3x the nodes of P2, so sizes ~0.4-0.5x the P2 sizes. After mesh() check node count and rescale h by (nodes/target)^(1/3).

[general] Before submit, tabulate each solve: DOFs, c = DOFs/automesher DOFs, e_est (compare vs finest, x~1.3), score (g/2)^2/c. Submit the max; never choose by gut feel. A cheaper solve (11.4k DOFs) once beat a 16k one but was not chosen.

[general] Pay line: below target, accept a refinement only if energy gain % >= 0.075 x DOF increase %; for DOF removal accept if energy loss % <= 0.075 x DOF cut %. f2 0.0025 gave 0.075% for 2.4% (needed 0.18%): rejected.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Strain energy rises toward convergence (0.03316 h0.03 < 0.03326 h0.019 < 0.03335 h0.012; fine 0.0335-0.0340). Higher energy = more accurate; rank by energy gain per DOF, never call lower energy better.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Spend solve 2 on one structural change (clamp box, tighter flank boxes, order), not tweaks <5% (noise, e.g. 19% stress change between solves 2-3).

[abc_00000065_bc0] Never drop band box [0.014,-0.026,-0.0081,0.028,0.024,-0.0035] 0.003: it saves only ~20 nodes (5274->5254) but +y lobe (h 0.0055, 11.6% VM), tier2 ymin edge and f2 held 12.6% of error. Field 8.67->8.89%, points 6.3->8.3%.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Price h 0.0065, 0.007, 0.0085 on the a14 recipe with free mesh() first. Global h is non-monotonic (h 0.007: 5028 vs 5254 nodes on yours, 5543 vs 5159 on a7's; h 0.009: 9733 nodes, quality 0.046 invalid). Never solve h 0.0075 or 0.009. Skip meshes within 5% of known nodes.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Don't re-solve the a14 control (2.13341e-4, 5277 nodes). Solves: best-priced h variant, second h variant, x0.75 reference (~9k nodes); compare each with reference, rank by compare×DOFs. Quality gate: h 0.008-0.007 gives 0.110-0.119; below 0.1 discard.

[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Plan: solve1 = P1 above; solve2 = order-2 control (h 0.008, bottom box 0.002, f7 0.0035 r0.004, upper box to y 0.024 at 0.004); compare(1,2). Solve3 = P1 sizes x0.85, compare(1,3). Solve4 = one-factor tweak of best.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Hidden worst point (10%) is near f5 at y~-0.025, low stress (disclosed P1 had -14%). Add mild f5 refinement size 0.004 r0.005.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Evidence to beat: a15 P1 (h 0.0033, 13.4k DOFs) energy 1.985e-4 vs 2.135e-4 P2, compare 15.5%. If P1 energy >3% below P2 or compare >0.12, report it and submit order 2.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Submit by score: above target score=g/(2c), so +8% DOFs must cut error >=8%. Pick the cheaper mesh when compare <~7% (noise). Solves 2/3 had near-equal DOFs (20k); make a solve a real cost cut (<15k DOFs).
[abc_00000065_bc0] Score 0.853 at 15.8k DOFs with error well under target (12.1%). Pay line: cut DOFs while error stays <12%. Compare solves only when DOFs differ >10%.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Linear tets converge about h^1 vs h^2 quadratic; expect order 1 to lose in the bending band at f5/f7 bottom (z≈-0.007). If compare(order1,order2) >0.2, document that order 1 is not worth it on this clamped plate.

[general] Clamp layer z≈-0.0072 beside f5/f7 (26-50% of error, only 4.5-5% VM at h 0.0027) is saturated. Don't touch tier1 (0.0021 priced more nodes, 5405, quality 0.1055); keep 0.0018 r0.003; order 1 needs ~0.001.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Highlight a3: box [0.012,-0.015,-0.0081,0.031,0.015,-0.003] size 0.0032 + f7 size 0.003 r 0.006 at h 0.008 gave 12.3% at 13215 DOFs, the best accuracy per DOF; base of the order-1 variant.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Highlight a14: a12 recipe with upper box ymax 0.012->0.015 (5277 nodes, same DOFs) gave field 8.54%, points 6.31%, base 0.787, best. Covering ±y at bottom/upper boundary pays when nearly free.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Global h sizes low-stress -y far field near f52 (y≈-0.037) and mid-thickness cells near f5 at -y; runs disagree 3-5%. After an h change check those hotspots/points (h 0.0075 gave 11.4% points).

[abc_00000065_bc0] P3 (0.0217,-0.0209,0) has -18.9% error and P1/P2 ~-10%: low-stress points under-predicted in coarse region. Test box [0.012,-0.03,-0.004,0.03,-0.012,0.004] at 0.004 to cut check-point RMS from 8.3%.
[abc_00000065_bc0] Coarsening test: f7 0.0035->0.0042 and upper box ->0.005 to cut DOFs below 13k; error 8.9% is far under the 12.1% target so cost dominates. Change one factor per solve.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Order 2 h 0.008 with bottom box and f7 0.0035 gives 7.8% at 20k DOFs (target 12.1%); a3's 12.3% at 13.2k scored better. Aim ~14-15k DOFs.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Upper box at 0.003 instead of 0.004 cost +1.5k DOFs for 4.6% field change (7.81% vs 8.15%) but best check-point RMS 5.33%; use only if check points bind. The +y box [0.012,0.012,-0.0081,0.028,0.024,0] at 0.0035 wasted elements (2-4%/cell): drop or use 0.005.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Pocket faces fix a floor of ~4500 nodes, so raising h is useless. Cut DOFs only by loosening local sizes, kept >=0.6x surrounding h.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Edge refinements on 22/23 (size 0.003) did not reach f5-bottom hotspots about 1 mm inside the part. Use a volume box over the band instead of edge-only refinement.
